```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# The bash chunks are the commands run on the server, shown for the record; they are not run when knitting.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
```

All sequenced males of known age (n = 152: 95 ASY, 57 SY), with **age class as a covariate**. Phenotype: card-corrected
mean mantle luminance (`lumMean_m`, from `01_data_cleaning.R` with `use_card_corrected <- TRUE`)

## Genotype likelihoods and SNP calling (loco-pipe)

Genotype likelihoods and global SNP calling with loco-pipe (ANGSD; Zhou et al.)
GATK genotype-likelihood model (`-GL 2`), minimum base and mapping quality 30 and 33, depth filter (mean ± 2 SD of
the total depth), at least 50% of birds with data, minor allele frequency ≥ 0.05, SNP p-value < 1e-6,
`-uniqueOnly 1 -trim 0 -C 50 -baq 1 -skipTriallelic 1`. Output: one beagle genotype-likelihood file per chromosome
(`angsd/snp_calling_global/<chr>.beagle.gz`) and all chromosomes combined.

```{bash snp calling}

snakemake --use-conda --conda-frontend conda --rerun-triggers mtime --scheduler greedy --cores 8 \
  --configfile config/config.yaml \
  --snakefile ~/software/loco-pipe/workflow/pipelines/loco-pipe.smk \
  --until snp_calling_global

```

## Phenotypes and covariates

Files made by `06b_GWAS_phenotype_inputs.R` (in `data/gwas_allages_inputs/`, copied to `inputs/` on the server).

- ANGSD (`-yQuant`): card-corrected mantle luminance, one value per bird.
- ANGSD (`-cov`): genomic PC1 and age class (0 = ASY, 1 = SY). Genomic PC1 is the first eigenvector of the PCAngsd
  covariance matrix (`--maf 0.05`) of all SNPs (PCAngsd v1.3, default iterations; 2% of the variance; r with age = 0.19).
- GEMMA BSLMM takes no covariates, so its phenotype is age-adjusted: the residuals of luminance ~ age class.

```{bash covariates}

# genomic PCA on the combined beagle file, then the ANGSD covariate files
pcangsd -b angsd/snp_calling_global/combined.beagle.gz --maf 0.05 -t 4 -o pcangsd/combined

```

## Imputation

Genotype probabilities imputed from the likelihoods with Beagle 3.3.2, one chromosome at a time. All chromosomes were then combined and checked against the input (4,510,808 SNPs in and out).


```{bash imputation}

# one chromosome (03a_impute_one_chr.sh; seeds tried in turn: default, 1234, 4321, 777)
java -Xmx16g -jar /programs/beagle3/beagle.jar like=angsd/snp_calling_global/$chr.beagle.gz out=$chr [seed=$seed]

# all chromosomes combined: imputed/btbw_n152_allages.gprobs.gz 

```

## ANGSD-asso

Score test with the latent genotype model (`-doAsso 5`) on the imputed genotype probabilities, covariates genomic
PC1 and age class.

```{bash angsd}

angsd -beagle imputed/btbw_n152_allages.gprobs.gz -fai mywagenomev2.1.fa.fai -P 4 \
  -doMaf 4 -doAsso 5 -minCount 5 \
  -yQuant inputs/yQuant_lumMean_m_cc.txt -cov inputs/angsd_cov_genomicPC1_age.txt \
  -out asso/btbw_n152_allages_lumMean_m_cc__PC1cov_age

```

## Permutation null for ANGSD-asso

The same association repeated 200 times with luminance shuffled among birds **of the same age class**, so the null
keeps the real age difference (age is a covariate). From the 200 runs: the median LRT of every 50-SNP window

```{bash permutation}

# each shuffle: the same angsd command with -yQuant = one column of the shuffle file (08_permutation_null.sh)
PERM_JOBS=6 bash 08_permutation_null.sh inputs/yQuant_lumMean_m_cc_perm200_withinage.tsv perm_withinage


```

## GEMMA BSLMM

Genotypes as BIMBAM dosages from the imputed probabilities (dosage = P(AB) + 2 P(BB)); centred relatedness matrix
(`-gk 1`). Three independent BSLMM chains of the age-adjusted phenotype (seeds 101, 202, 303; 0.5 M burn-in,
20 M sampling steps)

```{bash gemma}

# dosages and kinship (05_gemma_genotypes.sh)
gemma -g btbw_n152_allages.bimbam.gz -p inputs/gemma_phenotypes.txt -gk 1 -o kinship_btbw_n152_allages

# BSLMM, column 4 = age-adjusted card-corrected luminance (inputs/gemma_phenotypes_KEY.txt; 07_gemma_bslmm.sh).
for seed in 101 202 303; do
  gemma -g btbw_n152_allages.bimbam.gz -p inputs/gemma_phenotypes.txt -a btbw_n152_allages.snp_annotation.txt \
    -k output/kinship_btbw_n152_allages.cXX.txt -bslmm 1 -n 4 -w 500000 -s 20000000 -seed $seed \
    -o BSLMM_btbw_n152_allages_lumMean_m_cc_age_adjusted_seed$seed &
done
wait

```
